title: Choose how AI Stats evolves
question: Your steer is locked: preserve the current dark technical aesthetic. Choose the degree and structure of the upgrade.

options.label: Calibrated Console
options.lineage: the current AI Stats console, refined with scientific instrument discipline
options.thesis: Keep the product immediately recognizable while making every model decision more legible, attributable, and useful.
options.viewport: The familiar dark shell gains a task-first decision strip, a live shortlist, and compact source-backed tradeoff visualizations.
options.case: This keeps the current identity intact while fixing hierarchy, sparse-score ranking, provenance, and chart usefulness.
options.risk: It demands disciplined spacing and type or the familiar density will remain visually flat.

raised.raise: Use restrained source-routing lines only where they clarify how evidence produces a recommendation.
Give every consequential metric a visible source, date, version, scale, and coverage receipt.
Make freshness and ingestion health readable as instrument states, not buried metadata.

options.label: Evidence Matrix
options.lineage: the current dark UI fused with comparative scientific matrices and modern data notebooks
options.thesis: Turn the existing console into the clearest possible cross-source comparison surface without changing its character.
options.viewport: A sticky model matrix makes benchmark coverage, price, speed, and provenance comparable in one scan.
options.case: The matrix solves the product’s hardest information problem while staying closest to its existing data-dense aesthetic.
options.risk: The interface can become spreadsheet-like unless task presets and progressive disclosure lead the experience.

options.label: Signal Deck
options.lineage: the current AI Stats console with observability-grade time series and small multiples
options.thesis: Make changing model quality, price, speed, and source freshness the visual signature of the site.
options.viewport: A familiar overview adds high-information trend plots, benchmark deltas, and a compact recommended shortlist.
options.case: The strongest visualization upgrade, especially for model changes over time, with minimal brand disruption.
options.risk: Trend displays become noise unless the backend preserves dated observations and methodology changes cleanly.

canonCard.label: Current AI Stats, polished
canonCard.thesis: Keep the current layouts and visual grammar, then improve spacing, typography, accessibility, chart defaults, and data accuracy in place.
canonCard.viewport: The current homepage composition remains, with cleaner leaderboards, better filters, and clearer freshness labels.
canonCard.risk: The safest move may preserve the structural weaknesses that make the current product harder to use.
